input.source: user-provided lawful dump, kept outside git

X0.note: User-provided external retail XEX hash and title identity verified; no game binary or assets are tracked

X1.note: SDK v0.10.0 is pinned; eighteen live-memory-derived function entries have focused static regressions. ReXGlue codegen and Linux AMD64 build now accept the 68-byte 0x82341198 dispatcher; its runtime execution and the broader PPC/import/lowering report remain open.

X2.note: The plugin-enabled Linux AMD64 probe verified the retail VdEnableRingBufferRPtrWriteBack call with physical address 0x17AF403C and block-size log2 6. The GPU worker advanced the big-endian readback at descriptor+0x3C through values 25, 49, and 73; exact-XEX helper 0x823B2920 reads that +0x3C field. A clean follow-up GDB run watched the distinct descriptor+0x00 word, object+0x2ABD predicate, current KTHREAD+0x58 and object+13432: the queue stayed at 1, predicate at 0x14, and the two fields at zero; retail helper 0x823B33A0 was not entered during the observed interval. The timeout helper 0x823BA9C8 traps when object+13432 is null, so fabricating its trigger is not a valid fix. Runtime evidence confirms PM4_INTERRUPT source r3=1 reaches retail callback 0x823B37B8; this matches upstream Xenia PM4 dispatch semantics, so the earlier source-mapping concern is resolved. In a separate pristine probe, source r3=0 was not observed for about 110 seconds, while the predicate stayed 0x14 after a source-1 callback. The latest Process 2 plugin source stores the guest callback and dispatches PM4 source 1, but has no source-0/vblank path; ReXGlue's default GraphicsSystem::MarkVblank sends source 0. This is a concrete Process 2 integration gap to verify, not a proven cause of the wait. Keep guest semantics unchanged until the source-0 path and queue producer are verified.

X3.note: Process 2's latest Linux live evidence still reports two Vulkan frame submissions from the retail ring under shift-native, with two guest swaps; the unmodified retail output remains black and visible parity is unverified. P1's clean callback probe confirms source-1 PM4 delivery but does not observe source-0/vblank delivery. The missing source-0 path is a candidate integration gap for Process 2 to verify. The guest wait predicate and exact input-to-generated-executable correlation remain open; no playable frame or scene is claimed.

X4.note: The user confirmed that the original game's loading screen appeared during a ReXGlue Xbox run. The exact process/build hash was not recorded and the screen is no longer visible. The main menu, retail frame, and offline race remain unverified.

X5.note: No SHIFT Xbox runtime execution on target architectures

X6.note: Source audit found a Vulkan 1.1 path but three optional feature bits are hard requirements; device feature probe and retail draw/present proof are pending
